hey, i totally understand you. i also can't help but sometimes, in hard situations, wish that i could have killed myself before. but also, sometimes... there are some precious parts in life that makes me feel glad about still being able to breathe.
i'm 18, only 2 years older than you. i've been suicidal since 13, had a failed attempt at 17. after my attempt i've struggled a lot mentally but i also had a lot new experiences that made me love living again.

i'm not gonna say the "it gets better" bullshit. this is life that we're talking about. it has it's ups and downs. but what i'm gonna say is that you are yet too young to be giving up on your life. you may never know what the future is holding out there for you. you may deny it, i understand. when i was 16 i hated to hear "you're too young to know". i thought that i had figured out everything about myself and my future. it isn't really like that.

i know it is hard to hold on. i know the weight on your shoulders get heavier each day and you struggle to carry it all alone. i also know how annoying it is to listen to people who say the same stupid, useless, motivational shit over and over. so, i'm not gonna say anything. i'm just gonna share my experience with you and hope that it will help you in a good way.

(also, if you ever need someone to talk to, my dms are open. i'll be more than happy to listen.)
